## 简体中文

### Esse 1.1.0-beta.8

- 图片服务生成成功后，先在本地安全保存结果，再下载图片；同步结果下载失败或应用中断后，可继续取回同一结果，避免再次提交生图请求。
- 结果保存失败时保留服务请求 ID，并准确显示扣费状态未知；取回沿用原调用记录。结果文件缺失或损坏时明确报错，不会自动重新生成。
- 私密图片地址和图片内容保留在权限受限的本地结果文件中，不进入批次或 MCP 返回值；删除批次会清理这些结果文件。
- 云端兔子 2K 竖图实测已确认生成请求返回成功；图片下载被云环境 HTTPS 代理拒绝，因此实际像素、比例、参考图效果及服务实际扣费仍未完成验收。实体 Apple Silicon Mac 安装流程尚未验收。

[完整变更记录](https://github.com/renoir1220/esse-private/compare/v1.1.0-beta.7...v1.1.0-beta.8)

## English

### Esse 1.1.0-beta.8

- Completed Provider results are saved privately before image download. A failed synchronous download or interrupted application can retrieve the same result without submitting another generation request.
- Output-save failures retain the Provider request ID and an unknown charge state. Retrieval reuses the original call record. Missing or corrupt result files fail explicitly without automatic regeneration.
- Private image URLs and image content remain in permission-restricted local result files, outside batch and MCP responses. Deleting a batch removes these result files.
- Live cloud testing confirmed successful Tuzi 2K portrait generation responses. The cloud HTTPS proxy denied image downloads, so actual pixels, aspect ratio, reference-image effects and Provider debits remain unverified. Installation through the physical Apple Silicon Mac user flow remains unverified.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/renoir1220/esse-private/compare/v1.1.0-beta.7...v1.1.0-beta.8)
